Bottlepay is the next-generation bitcoin wallet and frictionless payment rail across social and commerce.

Digital Assets, Payments / Seed/ Exited

Digital payment rails are made up of complicated financial settlement processes—costing merchants up to 4% to accept purchases and involving a dozen or so different entities (each a distinct point of failure) to process a single transaction.
